card.name: Space before a dose amount
card.fires_on: The space (or first digit) right after a drug name or 'single' and just before a dose number such as 10 mg or 100 mg/m2. It is seen in dosing and drug-interaction text.

modes.label: After 'single'
modes.description: The gap between 'a single' and the dose number in interaction studies.
modes.example: had no effect on the pharmacokinetics of a single<< >>10 mg dose of warfarin

modes.label: After a drug name
modes.description: The gap between a drug name and its dose in regimen lists.

modes.label: After a drug name in a comparison list
modes.description: The gap between a drug name and its equivalent dose.

card.writes: It promotes unrelated odd tokens and suppresses 'tolerate' and 'tolerance' words, so there is no clear link to the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the small gap just before a dose number follows a drug name.
